_comment: BASELINE Claude API organization policy. Essential security with minimal friction. Suitable for startups and individual developers.

inference_hooks._comment: Claude Enterprise only. Inference hooks (AI security server allow/deny before inference) are not configured on Baseline. Leave organization_allowed false unless you run Claude Enterprise and operate a signed HTTPS verdict endpoint.

managed_agents._comment: Dreams (Managed Agents memory reorganization, research preview) has no org-wide disable switch yet. Do not request Dreams access on Baseline without a security review of memory-store contents.
